InstallerUpdates.AllUsers.zh: 此版本为所有用户安装。更新将打开安装向导，并需要管理员确认；当前画布会先保存到恢复记录。
InstallerUpdates.AllUsers.en: This copy is installed for all users. Updating opens Setup and requires administrator approval. The current canvas is saved for recovery first.

InstallerUpdates.NoSetup.zh: 发现新版本，但该版本未提供安装程序。请打开发布页查看说明；此安装位置不能直接应用 ZIP 更新。
InstallerUpdates.NoSetup.en: A newer release is available, but it has no Setup package. Open its release page for instructions; ZIP updates cannot be applied directly to this installation.

InstallerUpdates.Opening.zh: 正在打开安装程序，请完成管理员确认…
InstallerUpdates.Opening.en: Opening Setup. Please complete the administrator prompt…

InstallerUpdates.Cancelled.zh: 安装程序已取消或未能完成初始化，浮绘继续运行。
InstallerUpdates.Cancelled.en: Setup was cancelled or could not initialize. FloatCanvas is still running.

InstallerUpdates.Timeout.zh: 尚未收到安装程序的就绪确认。浮绘继续运行；请关闭未完成的安装窗口后重试。
InstallerUpdates.Timeout.en: Setup did not confirm it was ready. FloatCanvas is still running. Close any unfinished Setup window before trying again.

InstallerUpdates.ScopeChanged.zh: 安装位置或安装范围已改变，请重新打开“检查更新”后重试。
InstallerUpdates.ScopeChanged.en: The installation location or scope changed. Reopen Check for updates and try again.
